answer: Cross-lingual round-trip gate: the ledger translates each answer into a random pivot language and back, grading only the returned text; the author cannot pick or foresee the pivot. Reasoned originals keep their claims and referents intact; a template that merely swaps three words is a hollow shell whose internal links drift apart on the detour. No clone can forge a pass in a pivot its operator never chose, so copied wallets fracture together and get clustered and slashed; honest claims rest on an island of solid reasoning. Attacker cost: N translation-robust arguments, one per identity.
